target.title: fix(ios): render Markdown lists and thematic breaks
target.body:
Closes #104548

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where iOS users reading an agent response with Markdown lists would see list markers and item boundaries flattened into generic prose. The same path also left thematic breaks as literal Markdown instead of visual separators. This made structured answers harder to scan, especially for nested steps, task lists, and ordered choices.

## Why This Change Was Made

Completed top-level ordered, unordered, and task lists now render through a bounded native SwiftUI block while preserving nested lists, parsed ordered-list start values, reference-link scope, and semantic fenced or indented code. Top-level thematic breaks render as dividers. Streaming lists deliberately remain on the existing prose path until completion so progressive word reveal is unchanged.

Extraction is capped at 20 KB, 100 total items, and six nesting levels; unsupported or over-limit input falls back to the existing prose renderer. This PR does not change `MEDIA:` handling or the wire protocol. VoiceOver labels for list and task markers are localized through the repository's native-app i18n pipeline.

## User Impact

iOS conversations now preserve the structure of Markdown lists and thematic breaks. Numbering, nesting, task state, code blocks, and marker alignment remain readable at narrow widths, in light and dark appearance, and with accessibility text sizes.

## Evidence

Visual proof was captured on an iPhone 17 Pro simulator running iOS 26.5. Before the fix, the issue reproduction collapses list markers and line structure; after the fix, it renders as a native ordered list with nested/task content and a divider. Screenshots are attached below.

Exact-head validation at `1b73e5fa3a1ab2eb394e8504db753c952402a902`:

- Full `swift test` in `apps/shared/OpenClawKit`: 1,036 tests in 85 suites passed.
- Focused macOS Markdown suite: 91 of 91 tests passed.
- Focused iOS package suite on iPhone 17 Pro / iOS 26.5: 92 of 92 tests passed.
- App-level `SwiftUIRenderSmokeTests`: 26 of 26 tests passed, including light, dark, accessibility text, and 320-point-width coverage.
- Native, Android, and Apple localization consistency checks: passed; the two new VoiceOver labels are synchronized across 22 locales.
- SwiftFormat 0.62.1: 0 of 331 files require formatting.
- SwiftLint 0.65.0: 0 violations in 331 files.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`: clean.
- Repository `autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main`: no accepted or actionable findings; patch assessed correct with 0.78 confidence.

This PR is AI-assisted with Codex. I reviewed the implementation, understand its parsing, fallback, streaming, localization, accessibility, and rendering behavior, and ran the validation above.

### Before

![Before: Markdown list flattened into prose](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/metaforismo/openclaw/7fae6dda9d4165f8973c87388fd42f9bd26d3793/before.png)

### After

![After: native ordered, nested, and task list with thematic divider](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/metaforismo/openclaw/7fae6dda9d4165f8973c87388fd42f9bd26d3793/after.png)
